mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently
failure_condition: If the joint condition of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the combined effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS changes on 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of declining HOUST and GDPC1 is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the combined effect of HOUST and GDPC1 changes on 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 1 month during a tightening cycle is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 5-day forward returns during tightening cycles is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
